props.description: Input field error

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description: Controls weather to show error message or not.

props.name: message
props.description: Main text message displayed inside the toast.

props.name: type
props.description: Visual intent style of the toast.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Container variant style.
Defaults to `"accent"`.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional custom icon override slot.

props.name: showProgressBar
props.description:
Controls whether an animated auto-close progress bar is displayed.
Defaults to `true` when autoClose is enabled.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total duration in milliseconds for progress bar countdown.

props.name: isPaused
props.description: State indicating whether auto-close countdown is paused (e.g. on hover).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Triggers removal of the toast.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Position on screen where toasts appear.
Defaults to `"top-right"`.

props.name: maxToasts
props.description:
Maximum number of toasts visible simultaneously.
Defaults to `5`.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in pixels. Required for react-window's fixed-size virtualization.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the scrollable body in pixels.

props.name: overscanCount
props.description:
Number of extra rows rendered outside the visible area.
Higher values reduce blank flicker during fast scrolling at the cost of more DOM nodes.
Maps directly to react-window's overscanCount.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of data items

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions

props.name: sorting
props.description: Sorting state, keyed by column name

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading state — shows skeleton rows instead of data

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message or node shown when the items array is empty

props.name: onSort
props.description: External sorting handler. When omitted, DataTable auto-sorts internally.

props.name: rowKey
props.description:
Determines the stable React key for each row.
Pass a field name string or a function returning a unique value.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description:
Callback fired when a row is clicked.
Rows become visually interactive (pointer cursor) when this is set.

props.name: rowClass
density
props.description: Cell padding preset.

props.name: striped
props.description: Applies an alternating background to odd-indexed rows.

props.name: containerClass
props.description: Optional classes applied to the outer container div

props.name: wrapperClass
props.description: Optional classes applied to the scroll wrapper div

props.name: selectable
props.description: Renders a leading checkbox column so rows can be selected.

props.name: selectedRowKeys
props.description: Controlled selected row keys — pair with `onSelectionChange`.

props.name: defaultSelectedRowKeys
props.description: Initially selected row keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the new selected row keys and their matching items whenever selection changes.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description:
Marks specific rows as ineligible for selection — their checkbox is
disabled and they're excluded from "select all".

props.name: open
props.description: Controls the visibility of the dialog.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when clicking overlay or pressing the ESC key.

props.name: position
props.description: Dialog position on the screen.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls dialog width for center/top/bottom modes.

props.name: overlayClass
props.description: Custom classes for overlay.

props.name: panelClass
props.description: Custom classes for the panel.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Controls if Dialog should have a backdrop

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Controls if Dialog should close on ESC key press
